body:
Implements ADR-014 (docs/decisions/014-ua-stylesheet.md).

## Summary

Add a UA stylesheet module and make the cascade origin-aware. After this, an unstyled HTML page (h1 + p, zero author CSS) renders with heading hierarchy and paragraph gaps.

## Scope

### Change 1: ua_stylesheet module (new files)

src/renderer/css/ua_stylesheet.hpp:
  const Stylesheet& ua_stylesheet();

src/renderer/css/ua_stylesheet.cpp:
  Function-local static Stylesheet, parsed once from a CSS string constant.

Content per ADR-014:

  body   { margin: 8px }
  h1     { font-size: 2em; font-weight: bold; margin: 0.67em 0 }
  h2     { font-size: 1.5em; font-weight: bold; margin: 0.75em 0 }
  h3     { font-size: 1.17em; font-weight: bold; margin: 0.83em 0 }
  h4     { font-weight: bold; margin: 1.12em 0 }
  h5     { font-size: 0.83em; font-weight: bold; margin: 1.5em 0 }
  h6     { font-size: 0.67em; font-weight: bold; margin: 1.67em 0 }
  p      { margin: 1em 0 }
  em, i, cite, var, address { font-style: italic }
  strong, b { font-weight: bold }
  code, pre, kbd, samp, tt { font-family: monospace }
  ul, ol { margin: 1em 0; padding-left: 40px }
  a      { color: #0000EE }

### Change 2: Origin-aware cascade

cascade.hpp:
  - enum class Origin : uint8_t { UserAgent, Author }
  - CascadeValue gains: Origin origin = Origin::Author
  - New: ComputedStyleMap cascade(const Stylesheet& ua, const Stylesheet& author, const dom::Document&)
  - Keep old single-sheet overload; it delegates with empty UA sheet so existing tests are unaffected

cascade.cpp:
  - beats(a, b): importance first, then origin (Author beats UserAgent for normal declarations), then specificity, then source order
  - apply_rule takes Origin param and sets CascadeValue::origin
  - compute_styles: run ua.rules first then author.rules with a shared counter

### Change 3: Wire the pipeline

render_pipeline.cpp:
  auto styles = cascade(ua_stylesheet(), sheet, *doc_);

### Change 4: CMake

src/CMakeLists.txt: add renderer/css/ua_stylesheet.cpp
tests/CMakeLists.txt: add test_ua_stylesheet.cpp

## Behavior

Before / After, unstyled HTML with no author CSS:

  h1       16px no margin       becomes  32px bold margin 0.67em
  p        16px no margin       becomes  16px margin 1em 0
  body     no inset             becomes  8px margin
  a href   black                becomes  #0000EE blue

Origin test:

  UA:     h1 { color: navy }    (specificity 0,0,1)
  Author: *  { color: red }     (specificity 0,0,0)
  Origin-aware: h1 is RED (author beats UA before specificity)
  Concatenation: h1 would be NAVY (wrong per CSS 2.1 section 6.4.1)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] ua_stylesheet() returns cached Stylesheet parsed from the CSS above
- [ ] cascade(ua, author, doc) exists; old cascade(author, doc) still compiles (delegates with empty UA)
- [ ] Origin enum on CascadeValue; beats() honors origin before specificity
- [ ] New tests in test_ua_stylesheet.cpp: parses to expected rule count, spot-checks specific rules
- [ ] New origin tests in test_cascade.cpp: author-* beats UA h1, author-h1 beats UA h1, both-important unchanged
- [ ] Existing 154 tests still pass
- [ ] Manual: load a plain h1+p page, confirm 32px heading and paragraph gaps
- [ ] grep -rl "lexbor/" src/ returns only src/renderer/html/convert.cpp
- [ ] CI green

## Refs

- ADR-014: docs/decisions/014-ua-stylesheet.md
- ADR-013: docs/decisions/013-length-units.md
- ADR-010: docs/decisions/010-cascade.md
title: [Help Wanted]: Implement origin-aware cascade and UA stylesheet per ADR-014
